profile.name: Naveen Chauhan
profile.intro: Full Stack Developer with 2 years of backend development in Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask) and 1 year of MERN stack - building scalable APIs, automation services and polished front-ends.

paragraphs: I'm a self-taught, highly motivated developer who loves turning business requirements into scalable, secure and high-performance web applications.

I've spent **2 years** building backend systems with Python frameworks like **Django, FastAPI and Flask**, and **1 year** on the **MERN stack**, crafting dynamic interfaces with React.js and Next.js backed by Node.js.
I enjoy designing APIs, managing databases, automating complex workflows and shipping clean, maintainable code. I'm currently pursuing my MCA while working full time.

experience.description: Building insurance browser automation services using Python, FastAPI and Playwright, with AWS-backed task processing.
Migrated a monolith to FastAPI microservices and delivered full stack products with React, Next.js and Django.
Developed web applications across the MERN stack and Python frameworks, from APIs to responsive UIs.

projects.title: Browser Automation
projects.summary: Scalable insurance automation services for Hastings and West Bend.
points: Automated Home and Auto quotation workflows from login to quote generation.
Built data mapping modules turning JSON into carrier-specific portal formats.
Managed insured, homeowner, vehicle, driver, coverage and loss history data.
Integrated AWS SQS, S3 and databases for tasks, payload storage and tracking.
Added premium extraction, validation, retry logic, encrypted credentials and error reporting.

projects.title: App.reactful
projects.summary: Upgraded a monolithic WebApp2 Python app into a FastAPI microservices platform.
points: Migrated legacy code improving performance, scalability and maintainability.
Worked across 3 services: Client Handling, Analytics and Visitor Tracking.
Enabled mirror websites with real-time visitor analytics.
Let companies host multiple websites and manage live deployments.
Built the React frontend for site creation, insights and traffic monitoring.

projects.title: EmbroideryUS Textile
projects.summary: Textile marketplace where vendors bid on customer product requests.
points: Built the Next.js frontend: UI, routing and state management.
Created a new Vendor user role in Django beyond the Customer role.
Built separate role-based dashboards for Customers and Vendors.
Implemented bidding so vendors can view requests and submit custom offers.
Used Redux Toolkit for role-based rendering and access restriction.

projects.title: AskLex
projects.summary: AI-powered legal assistant with answers verified by lawyers.
points: Integrated OpenAI for instant AI answers and Socket.io for real-time chat.
Stripe integration for secure payments.
Lawyer verification, role-based access control and a responsive Angular UI.
Optimized Flask APIs and database queries for speed and security.

projects.title: Mediadrive.io
projects.summary: Peer-to-peer file sharing that moves large files without server storage.
points: WebRTC and WebSocket for secure browser-to-browser transfer.
Unique 3-phrase code system for sharing, inspired by MagicWormhole.
Custom FastAPI signaling server for handshakes and peer setup.
Clean responsive Next.js UI for selecting, uploading and downloading.

projects.title: Ecommerce Website
projects.summary: MERN e-commerce platform with an Admin Dashboard.
points: Redux Toolkit and RTK Query for state, Firebase for authentication.
Tailwind CSS for the UI.
Caching, custom hooks, code splitting and lazy loading for performance.

projects.title: Attendance
projects.summary: Attendance portal that makes logging in and recording attendance effortless.
points: Secure JWT authentication protecting the portal and data integrity.
Responsive React UI with lazy loading.
Efficient state management with Redux and Context API.
